statistic: pooled held-out pair-year log-loss improvement comparator_minus_new
null_generation: for every originally event-bearing pair independently, move its single event indicator uniformly to one of that pair's already observed risk-year rows; censored pairs remain all-zero; pair identity, row count, entry/end structure, event-pair count, outer folds, features, and connected components remain fixed
regularization: repeat frozen inner component-grouped CV separately for M2, M3W, M3H within every permutation using C={0.001,0.01,0.1,1.0}; ties choose smaller C
familywise_adjustment: max-T: for permutation b compute max(delta_M3W, delta_M3H). Adjusted p for each observed co-primary delta is (1 + count(max_null >= observed_delta))/(B+1)
outer_folds: reuse exact outer_fold assignments committed in feature matrix; never recompute from permuted outcomes
inner_components: derive person-connected components within each outer-training set; event-bearing component counts are invariant because permutation changes event year only, not event-pair status
decision_rule: a development lead still requires all frozen non-permutation conditions plus its max-T adjusted p <= 0.05
forbidden: changing features or C grid after seeing permutation results
substituting unadjusted p-values for the frozen familywise rule
